name: The Monk's Things (Không Hạc Di Vật)

bonuses.effect: Silence After the Twelfth (Thập Nhị Hậu Tịch)
bonuses.rule: each echo the Zither sounds adds one Resonance to its foe; when you stop playing (The Held Rest), a foe with 6 or more Resonance falls into the silence: its clock stops for 1 s and its casting is 30 % slower for 3 s.

story: Everything the monk left in the ravine in 620: the zither, the beads and the robe. Hà Thính Tùng holds all three, and the academy rule is that only a player of the twelfth movement may.
